name: Timely
description: Timely is appointment-booking and business-management software for salons, spas, barbers, and beauty businesses. Teams use it for calendars, online bookings, client records, services, sales, payments, reminders, staff, rosters, stock, marketing, and reporting.
agentUseSummary: Timely cannot be connected directly to Relay agents because the only customer API key Timely documents is issued specifically for its built-in Zapier integration, and Timely publishes no general third-party API, OAuth, API-key, or remote MCP contract.

blocked.label: Connect a Timely account
blocked.description: Timely does not publish a supported distributable OAuth, general API-key, or remote MCP connection contract for third-party software platforms.

blocked.label: Use Timely business data
blocked.description: The documented Timely API key is created inside Timely for its Zapier integration; Timely does not publish the endpoints, authentication contract, schemas, permissions, rate limits, or developer terms required for Relay to use that key independently.

blocked.label: Run Timely agent actions
blocked.description: Relay Console cannot repurpose a Zapier-only key, collect a Timely password, automate Timely's private application, or reverse engineer undocumented endpoints containing customer and appointment data.

approvalProfiles.label: Unavailable
approvalProfiles.description: No agent actions can be enabled without a supported direct Timely API, delegated OAuth contract, general API-key contract, or remote MCP service.

runtimeSupport.description: No documented public Timely account API or remote MCP service is available to mount as OpenClaw tools.
No documented public Timely account API or remote MCP service is available to mount as Hermes tools.

providerSetup.blocker: Timely documents an API key only as part of activating its built-in Zapier integration on the Innovate plan. The official setup guide instructs customers to paste that key into Zapier, while Timely publishes no general developer API origin, endpoint contract, authentication headers, schemas, permissions, action surface, versioning, rate limits, or distributable third-party terms for independent use by Relay.
providerSetup.nextAction: Do not request the Zapier-only key or show Connect. Reconsider Timely only if it publishes a supported distributable account API, delegated OAuth contract, general API-key contract, or remote MCP service, or grants Relay an explicit partner integration contract.

evidence.supports: Timely's official guide limits the customer API key to activating Timely's Zapier integration on the Innovate plan and instructs the user to paste that key into Zapier; it does not publish a general third-party API contract.

Timely documents a finite set of product-managed integrations, including Zapier, that customers connect from their Timely account; it does not present a developer platform or direct account API for arbitrary third-party apps.
Timely's current pricing describes the feature as a Zapier API available on the Innovate plan, not as a general customer API for independently developed integrations.
Timely's terms prohibit exploiting access to the service without express written permission and prohibit copying, modifying, or reverse engineering the service without prior written approval.
